# windowsddi_dns_records (Data Source)

Lists the records of a zone (`Get-DnsServerResourceRecord`), optionally filtered by name and type. Every record is returned, including the apex SOA and NS records and dynamic records, with its data rendered as a string in zone file form.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# All A records of a zone, for example to feed a source of truth.
data "windowsddi_dns_records" "a" {
  zone_name = "lab.example.local"
  type      = "A"
}

output "a_records" {
  value = {
    for r in data.windowsddi_dns_records.a.records : r.name => r.value...
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `zone_name` (String) Zone to list, for example `lab.example.local`. Case and a trailing dot are ignored.

### Optional

- `name` (String) Only return records of this name, relative to the zone (`@` for the apex). Records of child names are not included. Case is ignored.
- `type` (String) Only return records of this type, for example `A`, `MX` or `NS`. Case is ignored.

### Read-Only

- `records` (Attributes List) Matching records, sorted by name, type and value. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--records))

<a id="nestedatt--records"></a>
### Nested Schema for `records`

Read-Only:

- `dynamic` (Boolean) `true` for a dynamic record (registered by a client or the DHCP server, has a timestamp), `false` for a static one.
- `name` (String) Record name relative to the zone, lowercase, `@` for the apex.
- `ttl` (Number) Time to live in seconds.
- `type` (String) Record type in upper case, for example `A`.
- `value` (String) Record data in zone file form, for example `10.1.20.80` (A), `www.lab.example.local.` (CNAME), `10 mail.lab.example.local.` (MX), `10 60 5060 sip1.lab.example.local.` (SRV) or the quoted text (TXT).
